operation.h2: Create one ParserState over source at offset, invoke the exact pinned H2 consumeNumber parser once, and return its one intrinsic mutable {sign,type,value} leaf in one mutable {end,leaf} observation wrapper.
operation.deposed: Create one ParserState over source at offset, invoke the exact pinned historical number parser once, derive sign/type/end from the consumed source span without oracle fields, construct one equivalent mutable {sign,type,value} leaf, and return it in the same mutable {end,leaf} observation wrapper.
operation.scope: All 64 timed rows are in the exact common domain. Plus-sign and multiple-leading-zero behavioral differences are excluded from timing.

correctness_evidence.creation_command: Root captured the exact deterministic stdout of ../../../node_modules/.bin/tsx bench/benchmark.mts --validate and added it with apply_patch; cmp replay is required before timing.

attempt.creation: Controller opens this one path with wx before frozen binding and correctness-evidence verification.
attempt.persistence: Every complete NDJSON record is synchronously written with short-write accounting and fsynced before work continues. All work after the exclusive open is failure-guarded; final fsync and close are attempted independently.
attempt.failure: Any verification, spawn, IPC, semantic, checksum, timeout, stderr, signal, exit, persistence, or inference error terminally fails the sole attempt.
attempt.retry_policy: NONE. No restart, retry, replacement path, deletion, rewrite, truncation, V2, or alternate attempt is permitted.

protocol.child_order: Exactly the 30 listed seeds in array order; children are spawned sequentially, one at a time, and never restarted.
protocol.preflight: Every child validates both exact lanes against all 64 rows before any warmup or timed block.
protocol.warmup_schedule: Two [h2,deposed] and two [deposed,h2] paired blocks, shuffled with the replicate seed XOR 0xa5a5a5a5.
protocol.sample_schedule: Six [h2,deposed] and six [deposed,h2] paired blocks, Fisher-Yates shuffled by the frozen per-replicate seed. Every block is retained.
protocol.child_aggregate: d_r is the arithmetic mean of exactly 12 ln(h2_elapsed_ns/deposed_elapsed_ns) paired-block ratios in child r.
protocol.inference: The only estimator uses the 30 child d_r values: mean plus 1.6991270265 times sample_sd divided by sqrt(30), with n=30 and df=29.
protocol.qualification: PASS if and only if the one-sided 95% upper log-ratio bound is strictly less than zero; equality fails.
protocol.outliers: Retain all predeclared sample blocks and all 30 process aggregates. No deletion, trimming, winsorization, substitution, rerun, or retry.

environment_retention: The raw start/binding events retain exact manifest, corpus, lane, correctness, runtime, and harness bindings; the controller and every child retain their observed Node/V8/OS/CPU/memory environments.
